fields.label: Token Validity (Days)
fields.description: How long an unused sign link stays valid.

fields.label: Disable Reminders
fields.description: Signers who haven't signed are reminded 2 hours, 8 hours, 1 day, 2 days and 4 days after the document reaches them. Tick to stop sending reminders.

fields.label: Max Signature Size (px)
fields.description: Longest side of a signature image, drawn or uploaded, before it is stamped into the PDF and remembered. Larger only makes uploads and signed PDFs heavier. At least 200.
